classification.A: confirmatory replication; positive ecological claim may receive independent confirmation weight
classification.B: bounded robust/exploratory; discovery, robustness, triangulation or closed post-hoc description
classification.C: scope-limiting negative; falsification, failed prediction, failed transfer, or quantitative bound
classification.D: data/identifiability gate; ecological outcome not opened or not estimable

anti_double_counting: Signy concentration V2 is nested robustness, not a third replication.
N_eff growth robustness files form one evidence family and are not independent votes.
Paper2 synthetic recovery/support audits are estimability evidence, not biological outcome evidence.
Technical and quality audits never increase ecological replication counts.
manuscript_claim_rule: Headline positive claims must be supported by class A; class B can supply discovery/robustness/context, class C supplies boundaries, and classes D/E carry no positive ecological vote.
